links.outcome: Unassisted clinical reasoning after structured LLM-integrated residency training vs traditional teaching
links.effect: Unassisted clinical reasoning scores 7.32 ± 2.30 vs 5.12 ± 1.66 (P < 0.001); SP exam 80.88 vs 78.71 (P = 0.025); TSM-AL residents performed better without LLM than with it.
links.quote: In the unassisted final examination, the TSM-AL group demonstrated significantly higher clinical reasoning scores (7.32 ± 2.30 vs 5.12 ± 1.66, P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Structured pedagogical framework positioning LLMs as supervised cognitive auxiliaries with controlled information release, predefined reasoning tasks, and utilization guidelines in residency education
